+
+    def get_kv_cache_spec(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> KVCacheSpec:
+        return FullAttentionSpec(
+            block_size=vllm_config.cache_config.block_size,
+            num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+            head_size=self.head_dim,
+            head_size_v=self.head_dim,
+            dtype=self.kv_cache_torch_dtype,
+        )
+
+    def _apply_sparse_indexer_rope(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        index_q: torch.Tensor,
+        index_k: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        proxy_dim = int(index_q.shape[-1])
+        positions = positions.reshape(-1).to(device=index_q.device, dtype=torch.long)
+        q_shape = tuple(index_q.shape)
+        k_shape = tuple(index_k.shape)
+        q = index_q.reshape(q_shape[0], -1, proxy_dim)
+        k = index_k.reshape(k_shape[0], -1, proxy_dim)
+        q, k = self.sparse_indexer_rotary_emb(positions, q, k)
+        return q.reshape(q_shape), k.reshape(k_shape)
+
+    def _finish_indexer(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        index_q: torch.Tensor,
+        index_k: torch.Tensor,
+        index_z: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Indexer norm+rope and head scores, all local shapes.
+
+        Returns index_q [t, groups, heads_per_group, proxy] (float8_e4m3fn
+        on the fused path -- the kernel quantizes at the store and the
+        scoring op consumes it directly; bf16 on the non-fused fallback),
+        index_k [t, 1, proxy], index_z [t, 1, proxy],
+        weights [t, groups, heads_per_group] fp32.
+        """
+        num_tokens = int(hidden_states.shape[0])
+        proxy_dim = int(self.sparse_config.proxy_dim)
+        weights, _ = self.sparse_indexer_w(hidden_states)
+
+        num_index_q_heads = int(index_q.shape[-1]) // proxy_dim
+        num_index_k_heads = int(index_k.shape[-1]) // proxy_dim
+        heads_per_group = num_index_q_heads // self.num_kv_heads
+
+        index_k = self.sparse_indexer_k_norm(index_k.contiguous())
+        index_q = index_q.view(num_tokens, self.num_kv_heads, heads_per_group, proxy_dim).contiguous()
+        index_q = self.sparse_indexer_q_norm(index_q)
+        index_k = index_k.view(num_tokens, num_index_k_heads, proxy_dim).contiguous()
+        index_q, index_k = self._apply_sparse_indexer_rope(
+            positions,
+            index_q.reshape(num_tokens, -1, proxy_dim),
+            index_k,
+        )
+        index_q = index_q.reshape(num_tokens, self.num_kv_heads, heads_per_group, proxy_dim)
+        index_z = index_z.view(num_tokens, num_index_k_heads, proxy_dim).contiguous()
+
+        weights = weights.to(dtype=torch.float32)
+        weights = weights.view(num_tokens, self.num_kv_heads, heads_per_group)
+        weights = weights * (float(heads_per_group) ** -0.5)
+        return index_q, index_k, index_z, weights.contiguous()
+
+    def _write_kv(self, key: torch.Tensor, value: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        attn_metadata = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        if not isinstance(attn_metadata, dict):
+            return
+        md = attn_metadata[self.layer_name]
+        num_tokens = md.num_actual_tokens
+        k = key[:num_tokens].view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
+        v = value[:num_tokens].view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
+        key_cache, value_cache = self.kv_cache[0], self.kv_cache[1]
+        DeviceOperator.reshape_and_cache(k, v, key_cache, value_cache, md.slot_mapping[:num_tokens])
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        qkv, qkzg = self.qkv_indexer_proj(hidden_states)
+
+        if self.use_fused_qknorm_rope:
+            q, k, v = fused_qknorm_rope(
+                qkv,
+                self.q_norm.weight,
+                self.k_norm.weight,
+                self.rope_cos,
+                self.rope_sin,
+                positions,
+                head_dim=self.head_dim,
+                num_q_heads=self.num_heads,
+                num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+                rotary_pairs=self._fused_rotary_pairs,
+                eps=self.q_norm.variance_epsilon,
+                norm_weight_bias=1.0 if self.zero_centered else 0.0,
+            )
+        else:
+            q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+            q_by_head = q.view(*q.shape[:-1], self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+            q = self.q_norm(q_by_head.contiguous()).view(q.shape)
+            k_by_head = k.view(*k.shape[:-1], self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
+            k = self.k_norm(k_by_head.contiguous()).view(k.shape)
+            if self.use_rope:
+                q, k = self.rotary_emb(positions, q, k)
+
+        index_q_raw, index_k_raw, index_z_raw, gate = self.qkv_indexer_proj.split_indexer(qkzg)
+        index_q, index_k, index_z, weights = self._finish_indexer(
+            positions, hidden_states, index_q_raw, index_k_raw, index_z_raw
+        )
+
+        num_tokens = int(hidden_states.shape[0])
+        query = q.view(num_tokens, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+        output = torch.empty(
+            (num_tokens, self.num_heads, self.head_dim),
+            dtype=q.dtype,
+            device=q.device,
+        )
+        # Load main KV and CSA summary before writing the prompt remainder.
+        wait_for_kv_layer_from_connector(self.layer_name)
+        self._write_kv(k, v)
+        self.impl.forward(
+            self,
+            query,
+            self.kv_cache,
+            index_q,
+            index_k,
+            index_z,
+            weights,
+            output,
+            positions,
+        )
+        # Summary writes and attention have completed submission for this layer.
+        maybe_save_kv_layer_to_connector(self.layer_name, list(self.kv_cache))
+        attn_output = output.view(num_tokens, self.num_heads * self.head_dim)
+        if gate is not None:
+            attn_output = (
+                attn_output.view(num_tokens, self.num_heads, self.head_dim) * gate.unsqueeze(-1).sigmoid()
+            ).view(num_tokens, -1)
+        output_tensor, _ = self.o_proj(attn_output)
+        return output_tensor
+
+
+class AscendStep5Attention(nn.Module):
+    """Step5 sliding-window layer on Ascend.
+
+    Built instead of the upstream ``Step5Attention`` so the dense layers run
+    on the platform-selected Ascend attention backend (upstream pins a CUDA
+    FlashAttention backend and a CUDA fused QKNorm+RoPE cache op). The
+    projections, norms and RoPE mirror the upstream construction; the
+    QKNorm+RoPE runs through the Ascend SIMD Triton kernel for head_dim=192.
+    The KV cache spec comes from the inner platform ``Attention`` layer
+    (registered as ``{prefix}.attn``), so this wrapper is a plain module.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        num_heads: int,
+        num_kv_heads: int,
+        max_position: int = 4096 * 32,
+        head_dim: int | None = None,
+        rms_norm_eps: float = 1e-06,
+        qkv_bias: bool = False,
+        rope_theta: float | list[float] | None = 10000,
+        cache_config: Any | None = None,
+        quant_config: Any | None = None,
+        rope_scaling: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+        sliding_window: int | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        use_head_wise_attn_gate: bool = False,
+        layer_types: list | None = None,
+        use_rope_layers: list | None = None,
+        yarn_only_types: list | None = None,
+        swa_num_attention_heads: int | None = None,
+        partial_rotary_factor: float = 1.0,
+        zero_centered: bool = True,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig | None = None,
+        sparse_config: Step5SparseConfig | None = None,
+        norm_dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        assert vllm_config is not None
+        assert sparse_config is None, "AscendStep5Attention serves dense layers only"
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.total_num_heads = num_heads
+        self.prefix = prefix
+        self.layer_idx = extract_layer_index(prefix)
+        tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+
+        if isinstance(rope_theta, list):
+            rope_theta = _per_layer_value(rope_theta, self.layer_idx, name="rope_theta", default=None)
+
+        self.num_heads = self.total_num_heads // tp_size
+        self.total_num_kv_heads = num_kv_heads
+        self.num_kv_heads = max(1, self.total_num_kv_heads // tp_size)
+        self.head_dim = head_dim or hidden_size // self.total_num_heads
+        self.partial_rotary_factor = float(partial_rotary_factor)
+        self.rotary_dim = int(self.head_dim * self.partial_rotary_factor)
+        self.q_size = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.kv_size = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5
+        self.zero_centered = zero_centered
+        self.use_head_wise_attn_gate = use_head_wise_attn_gate
+        self.use_rope = bool(_per_layer_value(use_rope_layers, self.layer_idx, name="use_rope_layers", default=True))
+        if norm_dtype is None:
+            norm_dtype = get_step5_norm_dtype(vllm_config.model_config.hf_config)
+
+        self.qkv_proj = QKVParallelLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.total_num_heads,
+            self.total_num_kv_heads,
+            bias=qkv_bias,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.qkv_proj",
+        )
+        self.params_dtype = self.qkv_proj.params_dtype
+        self.o_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            self.total_num_heads * self.head_dim,
+            hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.o_proj",
+        )
+        if use_head_wise_attn_gate:
+            self.g_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+                hidden_size,
+                self.total_num_heads,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.g_proj",
+            )
+
+        rope_parameters: dict[str, Any] = dict(rope_scaling) if rope_scaling is not None else {}
+        rope_parameters.setdefault("rope_type", "default")
+        if rope_theta is not None:
+            rope_parameters["rope_theta"] = rope_theta
+        rope_parameters["partial_rotary_factor"] = partial_rotary_factor
+        self.rotary_emb = get_rope(
+            head_size=self.head_dim,
+            max_position=max_position,
+            rope_parameters=rope_parameters,
+            dtype=self.params_dtype,
+        )
+        self.q_norm = AscendStep5RMSNorm(
+            self.head_dim,
+            eps=rms_norm_eps,
+            zero_centered=zero_centered,
+            dtype=norm_dtype,
+        )
+        self.k_norm = AscendStep5RMSNorm(
+            self.head_dim,
+            eps=rms_norm_eps,
+            zero_centered=zero_centered,
+            dtype=norm_dtype,
+        )
+
+        # The vLLM Attention layer resolves the backend through the platform
+        # selector (AscendFlashAttentionBackend for GQA/SWA on NPU).
+        self.attn = Attention(
+            self.num_heads,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.scaling,
+            num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.attn",
+            per_layer_sliding_window=sliding_window,
+        )
+
+        self.use_fused_qknorm_rope = self.use_rope and self.head_dim == 192
+        if self.use_fused_qknorm_rope:
+            self._fused_rotary_pairs = self.rotary_dim // 2
+            rotary_cache = self.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache
+            self.rope_cos, self.rope_sin = rotary_cache.chunk(2, dim=-1)
+        else:
+            self._fused_rotary_pairs = 0
+            self.rope_cos = None
+            self.rope_sin = None
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+        if self.use_fused_qknorm_rope:
+            q, k, v = fused_qknorm_rope(
+                qkv,
+                self.q_norm.weight,
+                self.k_norm.weight,
+                self.rope_cos,
+                self.rope_sin,
+                positions,
+                head_dim=self.head_dim,
+                num_q_heads=self.num_heads,
+                num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+                rotary_pairs=self._fused_rotary_pairs,
+                eps=self.q_norm.variance_epsilon,
+                norm_weight_bias=1.0 if self.zero_centered else 0.0,
+            )
+        else:
+            q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+            q_by_head = q.view(*q.shape[:-1], self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+            q = self.q_norm(q_by_head.contiguous()).view(q.shape)
+            k_by_head = k.view(*k.shape[:-1], self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
+            k = self.k_norm(k_by_head.contiguous()).view(k.shape)
+            if self.use_rope:
+                q, k = self.rotary_emb(positions, q, k)
+
+        attn_output = self.attn(q, k, v)
+        extra_dims = None
+        if self.use_head_wise_attn_gate:
+            extra_dims, _ = self.g_proj(hidden_states)
+            attn_output = (
+                attn_output.view(*attn_output.shape[:-1], self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+                * extra_dims.unsqueeze(-1).sigmoid()
+            ).view(*attn_output.shape)
+        output, _ = self.o_proj(attn_output)
+        return output
+
+
+class AscendStep5MoE(nn.Module):
+    """Step5 MoE block wired to the vllm-ascend fused MoE runner.
+
+    A standalone nn.Module assembled in a single pass, MiniMaxM3MoE /
+    AscendKimiMoE / Glm5NextMoE style -- the upstream ``Step5MoE.__init__``
+    is not reused: it would allocate a complete routed-experts runner
+    through the patched ``FusedMoEFactory`` that this block then discards
+    and rebuilds, so every MoE layer's expert weights would be allocated
+    twice. Every attribute the moe-collection / EPLB gates read (the n_*
+    metadata family, gate, router_bias, share_expert, experts) is set here
+    with upstream-compatible names and prefixes; the gates in
+    ``AscendStep5ForCausalLM`` dispatch on this class instead of
+    ``Step5MoE``.
+
+    Differences vs the upstream block (mirroring the proven MRV1 wiring):
+
+    - Shared expert: built with ``reduce_results=False`` and handed to
+      ``FusedMoEFactory(shared_experts=...)`` so ``AscendMoERunner`` owns its
+      execution: the shared/routed sum and the TP reductions happen inside
+      the runner, and the shared expert can overlap the routed experts on a
+      separate stream via ``multistream_overlap_shared_expert``. The block's
+      forward returns a single complete tensor instead of a
+      (shared, routed) tuple.
+    - MoE sequence parallelism: ``is_sequence_parallel=enable_sp_moe`` drives
+      the runner's EP all-gather/reduce-scatter path so the MoE consumes the
+      sequence shard directly (the AG-attn-RS-MoE(shard) decoder loop).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+
+        self.tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        self.layer_idx = extract_layer_index(prefix)
+
+        ep_size = get_ep_group().device_group.size()
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+        parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+
+        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
+        self.enable_eplb = parallel_config.enable_eplb
+        self.n_routed_experts = config.moe_num_experts
+        self.n_logical_experts = self.n_routed_experts
+        self.n_redundant_experts = parallel_config.eplb_config.num_redundant_experts
+        self.n_physical_experts = self.n_logical_experts + self.n_redundant_experts
+        self.n_local_physical_experts = self.n_physical_experts // ep_size
+
+        if self.tp_size > config.moe_num_experts:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Tensor parallel size {self.tp_size} is greater than the number of experts {config.moe_num_experts}."
+            )
+        self.gate = GateLinear(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            config.moe_num_experts,
+            bias=False,
+            out_dtype=torch.float32,
+            params_dtype=torch.float32,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.gate",
+        )
+        if not config.use_moe_router_bias:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 MoE currently requires use_moe_router_bias=true.")
+        self.router_bias = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.zeros(config.moe_num_experts, dtype=torch.float32),
+            requires_grad=False,
+        )
+        if not config.need_fp32_gate:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 MoE requires need_fp32_gate=true for stable router logits.")
+
+        activation = "silu"
+        swiglu_limits = config.swiglu_limits or []
+        swiglu_limit = swiglu_limits[self.layer_idx] if self.layer_idx < len(swiglu_limits) else None
+        if swiglu_limit not in (None, 0):
+            activation = "swiglustep"
+
+        enable_sp_moe = parallel_config.use_sequence_parallel_moe
+
+        _, reduce_results = _step5_moe_reduce_policy(
+            self.tp_size,
+            get_dp_group().world_size,
+        )
+
+        self.share_expert = Step5MLP(
+            config=config,
+            hidden_size=self.hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size=config.share_expert_dim,
+            hidden_act="silu",
+            reduce_results=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.share_expert",
+        )
+
+        self.experts = FusedMoEFactory(
+            shared_experts=self.share_expert,
+            num_experts=config.moe_num_experts,
+            top_k=config.moe_top_k,
+            hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size=config.moe_intermediate_size,
+            reduce_results=reduce_results,
+            scoring_func=getattr(config, "moe_router_activation", "sigmoid"),
+            renormalize=config.norm_expert_weight,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            activation=activation,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.experts",
+            e_score_correction_bias=self.router_bias,
+            routed_scaling_factor=config.moe_router_scaling_factor,
+            enable_eplb=self.enable_eplb,
+            num_redundant_experts=self.n_redundant_experts,
+            is_sequence_parallel=enable_sp_moe,
+            router_logits_dtype=torch.float32,
+        )
+        # Ascend dispatch sizes the global physical expert space from this
+        # metadata (mirrors the upstream block and MiniMaxM3MoE).
+        self.experts.global_redundant_expert_num = self.n_redundant_experts
+        self.experts.moe_config.global_redundant_expert_num = self.n_redundant_experts
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        input_is_sequence_parallel: bool = False,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        hidden_dim = hidden_states.shape[-1]
+        hidden_states = hidden_states.view(-1, hidden_dim)
+        # Sequence-parallel state is carried by the runner's FusedMoEConfig.
+        if self.experts.moe_config.is_sequence_parallel and not input_is_sequence_parallel:
+            hidden_states = sp_shard(hidden_states)
+
+        if self.experts.is_internal_router:
+            # Internal-router runners compute the gate themselves and the
+            # runner sums the shared expert into the routed output.
+            return self.experts(hidden_states=hidden_states, router_logits=hidden_states)
+        router_logits, _ = self.gate(hidden_states)
+        # Single complete tensor: AscendMoERunner sums the shared expert
+        # output internally and applies the required TP reductions.
+        return self.experts(hidden_states=hidden_states, router_logits=router_logits)
+
+
+class AscendStep5MLP(Step5MLP):
+    """Dense Step5 FFN under sequence parallelism (Kimi-K3 / MiniMax-M3 wiring).
+
+    TP-sharded weights must see the same token rows before the row-parallel
+    reduction, so the local sequence shard is gathered back to the padded
+    full sequence, the down projection stays unreduced, and
+    ``sp_reduce_scatter`` sums the TP partials straight back into the
+    rank-local shard (an all-reduce + re-shard fused into one collective).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *args,
+        sequence_parallel: bool = False,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> None:
+        # Under SP the down projection must not all-reduce: partial sums of
+        # *different* token shards would be added together.
+        if sequence_parallel:
+            kwargs["reduce_results"] = False
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        self.sequence_parallel_mlp = sequence_parallel
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.sequence_parallel_mlp:
+            hidden_states = sp_all_gather(hidden_states)
+        output = super().forward(hidden_states)
+        if self.sequence_parallel_mlp:
+            output = sp_reduce_scatter(output)
+        return output
+
+
+class AscendStep5DecoderLayer(Step5DecoderLayer):
+    """Upstream decoder layer with the attention swapped per layer type.
+
+    DSA (full-attention) layers get the Ascend DSA module; sliding layers get
+    the dense Ascend module on the platform backend. The forward mirrors the
+    upstream Step5DecoderLayer flow (unfused add + gemma norms) including the
+    sequence-parallel all-gather/reduce-scatter placement around attention.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        nn.Module.__init__(self)
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
+        self.fp32_residual_connection = config.fp32_residual_connection
+        layer_idx = extract_layer_index(prefix)
+        self.layer_idx = layer_idx
+        cache_config = vllm_config.cache_config
+        quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+
+        sliding_window = getattr(config, "sliding_window", None)
+        if sliding_window is None:
+            sliding_window = getattr(vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config, "sliding_window", None)
+        if sliding_window is None and cache_config is not None:
+            sliding_window = cache_config.sliding_window
+        if cache_config is not None:
+            cache_config = copy(cache_config)
+            cache_config.sliding_window = None
+
+        sparse_config = get_step5_sparse_config(config)
+        use_dsa_for_layer = sparse_config is not None and _is_step5_full_attention_layer(
+            config, layer_idx, sparse_config
+        )
+
+        norm_dtype = get_step5_norm_dtype(config)
+        layer_types = _get_step5_layer_types(config)
+        partial_rotary_factors = getattr(config, "partial_rotary_factors", [])
+        partial_rotary_factor = float(
+            _per_layer_value(
+                partial_rotary_factors,
+                layer_idx,
+                name="partial_rotary_factors",
+                default=1.0,
+            )
+        )
+        max_position = getattr(config, "max_position_embeddings", None)
+        if max_position is None:
+            max_position = vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len
+
+        # Both layer families share 64 heads / 4 kv groups / head_dim 192 in
+        # this checkpoint (num_attention_heads == num_sliding_attention_heads),
+        # so config defaults resolve correctly for both.
+        attn_kwargs = dict(
+            hidden_size=self.hidden_size,
+            num_heads=config.num_attention_heads,
+            max_position=max_position,
+            num_kv_heads=config.num_attention_groups,
+            rope_theta=config.rope_theta,
+            rms_norm_eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            qkv_bias=getattr(config, "attention_bias", False),
+            head_dim=getattr(config, "head_dim", None),
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            rope_scaling=getattr(config, "rope_scaling", None),
+            sliding_window=sliding_window,
+            use_head_wise_attn_gate=getattr(config, "use_head_wise_attn_gate", False),
+            layer_types=layer_types,
+            use_rope_layers=getattr(config, "use_rope_layers", []),
+            yarn_only_types=getattr(config, "yarn_only_types", []),
+            swa_num_attention_heads=getattr(config, "swa_num_attention_heads", None),
+            partial_rotary_factor=partial_rotary_factor,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.self_attn",
+            zero_centered=config.zero_centered,
+            vllm_config=vllm_config,
+            norm_dtype=norm_dtype,
+        )
+        if use_dsa_for_layer:
+            self.self_attn = AscendStep5DSAAttention(
+                sparse_config=sparse_config,
+                **attn_kwargs,
+            )
+        else:
+            self.self_attn = AscendStep5Attention(
+                sparse_config=None,
+                **attn_kwargs,
+            )
+
+        self.use_sequence_parallel = vllm_config.parallel_config.use_sequence_parallel_moe
+        self.use_moe = False
+
+        moe_layers_idx = _get_step5_moe_layer_indices(config)
+        if layer_idx in moe_layers_idx:
+            self.moe = AscendStep5MoE(
+                vllm_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.moe",
+            )
+            self.use_moe = True
+        else:
+            self.mlp = AscendStep5MLP(
+                config=config,
+                hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+                intermediate_size=config.intermediate_size,
+                hidden_act="silu",
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                reduce_results=True,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.mlp",
+                sequence_parallel=self.use_sequence_parallel,
+            )
+        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
+            # Upstream wiring: drop the o_proj all-reduce; the layer
+            # reduce-scatters the partial attention output into sequence
+            # shards right after the projection.
+            self.self_attn.o_proj.reduce_results = False
+        self.input_layernorm = AscendStep5RMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            zero_centered=config.zero_centered,
+            dtype=norm_dtype,
+        )
+        self.post_attention_layernorm = AscendStep5RMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            zero_centered=config.zero_centered,
+            dtype=norm_dtype,
+        )
+
+    def _forward_ffn(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        padding: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.use_moe:
+            ffn_output = self.moe(hidden_states, input_is_sequence_parallel=self.use_sequence_parallel)
+            if self.moe.experts.moe_config.is_sequence_parallel:
+                return ffn_output
+            return self._cast_for_residual(ffn_output)
+        return self.mlp(hidden_states)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        padding: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if residual is not None:
+            hidden_states = self._add_for_residual(hidden_states, residual)
+        residual = hidden_states
+        hidden_states = self.input_layernorm(hidden_states)
+        hidden_states = self._cast_for_param_op(hidden_states)
+
+        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
+            hidden_states = sp_all_gather(hidden_states)[: positions.shape[0]]
+        hidden_states = self.self_attn(
+            positions=positions,
+            hidden_states=hidden_states,
+        )
+        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
+            hidden_states = sp_reduce_scatter(hidden_states)
+
+        hidden_states = self._add_for_residual(hidden_states, residual)
+        residual = hidden_states
+        hidden_states = self.post_attention_layernorm(hidden_states)
+        hidden_states = self._cast_for_param_op(hidden_states)
+
+        ffn_output = self._forward_ffn(hidden_states, padding=padding)
+        return ffn_output, residual
+
+
+class AscendStep5Model(Step5Model):
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        nn.Module.__init__(self)
+        # The DSA modules hold python-side per-layer state; stay eager.
+        self.do_not_compile = True
+        self.vllm_config = vllm_config
+        # Switched like the other Ascend MoE models; drives the shard-at-
+        # entry / gather-at-exit forward below and the per-layer SP wiring.
+        self.use_sequence_parallel = vllm_config.parallel_config.use_sequence_parallel_moe
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        self.vocab_size = config.vocab_size
+        self.config = config
+        self.fp32_residual_connection = config.fp32_residual_connection
+        self.moe_num_experts = config.moe_num_experts
+        self.parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+
+        if get_pp_group().is_first_rank or (config.tie_word_embeddings and get_pp_group().is_last_rank):
+            self.embed_tokens = VocabParallelEmbedding(
+                self.vocab_size,
+                config.hidden_size,
+            )
+        else:
+            self.embed_tokens = PPMissingLayer()
+
+        self.start_layer, self.end_layer, self.layers = make_layers(
+            config.num_hidden_layers,
+            lambda prefix: AscendStep5DecoderLayer(
+                vllm_config,
+                prefix=prefix,
+            ),
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.layers",
+        )
+        if get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            norm_dtype = get_step5_norm_dtype(config)
+            self.norm = AscendStep5RMSNorm(
+                config.hidden_size,
+                eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+                zero_centered=config.zero_centered,
+                dtype=norm_dtype,
+            )
+        else:
+            self.norm = PPMissingLayer()
+
+        self.make_empty_intermediate_tensors = make_empty_intermediate_tensors_factory(
+            ["hidden_states"], config.hidden_size
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None = None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if get_pp_group().is_first_rank:
+            if inputs_embeds is not None:
+                hidden_states = inputs_embeds
+            else:
+                hidden_states = self.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+        else:
+            assert intermediate_tensors is not None
+            hidden_states = intermediate_tensors["hidden_states"]
+        hidden_states = self._cast_for_residual(hidden_states)
+        padding = None
+        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
+            padding = _step5_sp_padding(hidden_states)
+            hidden_states = sp_shard(hidden_states)
+        residual = None
+        for i in range(self.start_layer, self.end_layer):
+            layer = self.layers[i]
+            hidden_states, residual = layer(positions, hidden_states, residual, padding=padding)
+        if residual is not None:
+            hidden_states = layer._add_for_residual(hidden_states, residual)
+        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
+            hidden_states = sp_all_gather(hidden_states)[: positions.shape[0]]
+
+        if not get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            return IntermediateTensors(
+                {
+                    "hidden_states": hidden_states,
+                }
+            )
+
+        return hidden_states
+
+
+# ModelSlim MXFP8 checkpoints store the routed-expert projections fused
+# across all experts as 2D "[num_experts * out_features, in_features]"
+# tensors, while the upstream Step5 loader requires 3D stacked
+# "[num_experts, out_features, in_features]" tensors. The suffixes mirror
+# the upstream expert_params_mapping weight names; ".moe.share_expert.*"
+# and the dense-MLP projections must not match.
+_STEP5_FUSED_EXPERT_2D_SUFFIXES = (
+    ".moe.gate_proj.weight",
+    ".moe.up_proj.weight",
+    ".moe.down_proj.weight",
+    ".moe.gate_proj.weight_scale",
+    ".moe.up_proj.weight_scale",
+    ".moe.down_proj.weight_scale",
+    ".moe.gate_proj.input_scale",
+    ".moe.up_proj.input_scale",
+    ".moe.down_proj.input_scale",
+)
+
+
+def _reshape_step5_fused_expert_weights(
+    weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]],
+    num_experts: int,
+) -> Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+    """Reshape 2D fused-expert checkpoint tensors to the 3D stacked layout.
+
+    Only tensors with an expert-projection suffix, a 2D shape, and a leading
+    dimension that is a non-trivial multiple of ``num_experts`` are reshaped;
+    everything else passes through untouched (the reshape is a view).
+    """
+    for name, tensor in weights:
+        if (
+            tensor.ndim == 2
+            and name.endswith(_STEP5_FUSED_EXPERT_2D_SUFFIXES)
+            and tensor.shape[0] != num_experts
+            and tensor.shape[0] % num_experts == 0
+        ):
+            tensor = tensor.reshape(num_experts, tensor.shape[0] // num_experts, tensor.shape[1])
+        yield name, tensor
+
+
+class AscendStep5ForCausalLM(Step5ForCausalLM):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ):
+        nn.Module.__init__(self)
+        self.vllm_config = vllm_config
+        model_config = vllm_config.model_config
+        config = model_config.hf_config
+        self.config = config
+        self.fp32_residual_connection = config.fp32_residual_connection
+        self.model = AscendStep5Model(vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "model"))
+        self.num_logical_experts: int
+        self.num_physical_experts: int
+        self.num_local_physical_experts: int
+        self.num_redundant_experts: int
+        if get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            self.lm_head = ParallelLMHead(
+                config.vocab_size,
+                config.hidden_size,
+                quant_config=vllm_config.quant_config,
+                prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "lm_head"),
+            )
+            if config.tie_word_embeddings:
+                self.lm_head = self.lm_head.tie_weights(self.model.embed_tokens)
+            self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(config.vocab_size)
+        else:
+            self.lm_head = PPMissingLayer()
+
+        self.make_empty_intermediate_tensors = self.model.make_empty_intermediate_tensors
+
+        # Set MoE hyperparameters
+        self.moe_layers: list[Any] = []
+        example_layer: AscendStep5MoE | None = None
+        for layer in self.model.layers:
+            if isinstance(layer, PPMissingLayer):
+                continue
+            if hasattr(layer, "moe") and isinstance(layer.moe, AscendStep5MoE):
+                example_layer = layer.moe
+                self.moe_layers.append(layer.moe.experts)
+        _set_step5_moe_protocol_metadata(self, example_layer)
+
+    def update_physical_experts_metadata(
+        self,
+        num_physical_experts: int,
+        num_local_physical_experts: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        if self.num_local_physical_experts != num_local_physical_experts:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 EPLB cannot change the number of local physical experts: "
+                f"expected={self.num_local_physical_experts}, "
+                f"got={num_local_physical_experts}."
+            )
+        self.num_physical_experts = num_physical_experts
+        self.num_local_physical_experts = num_local_physical_experts
+        self.num_redundant_experts = num_physical_experts - self.num_logical_experts
+        for layer in self.model.layers:
+            if isinstance(layer, PPMissingLayer):
+                continue
+            moe = getattr(layer, "moe", None)
+            if not isinstance(moe, AscendStep5MoE):
+                continue
+            moe.n_local_physical_experts = num_local_physical_experts
+            moe.n_physical_experts = num_physical_experts
+            moe.n_redundant_experts = self.num_redundant_experts
+            moe.experts.update_expert_map()
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        # Adapt 2D fused-expert tensors (ModelSlim MXFP8 layout) to the 3D
+        # stacked layout the upstream loader expects.
+        return super().load_weights(_reshape_step5_fused_expert_weights(weights, self.model.moe_num_experts))

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Ascend Step5 MTP draft model.
+
+The upstream ``Step5MTP`` builds CUDA decoder blocks in its predictor
+layers. This module keeps the upstream wire format and interfaces
+(``forward``/``compute_logits``/``get_top_tokens``/``load_weights`` are all
+inherited untouched) and only re-creates the ``__init__`` paths so the draft
+transformer block runs through ``AscendStep5DecoderLayer`` -- the platform
+Ascend attention backends plus the NPU kernels already proven on the target
+model. The MTP layers are dense sliding layers, so they land on the platform
+sliding-window backend, not DSA.
+
+Weight loading, module names and parameter names mirror the upstream
+implementation exactly, so the checkpoint's ``model.layers.92.*`` MTP
+weights load unchanged.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from copy import deepcopy
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.config.utils import replace
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessor
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import (
+    VocabParallelEmbedding,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import WeightsMapper, maybe_prefix
+from vllm.models.step5.nvidia.layernorm import get_step5_norm_dtype
+from vllm.models.step5.nvidia.model import _set_step5_moe_protocol_metadata
+from vllm.models.step5.nvidia.mtp import (
+    Step5MTP,
+    Step5MTPSharedHead,
+    Step5MultiTokenPredictor,
+    Step5MultiTokenPredictorLayer,
+    _get_mtp_config,
+    _get_mtp_vllm_config,
+    _is_step5_mtp_dense,
+)
+
+from vllm_ascend.models.step5.model import AscendStep5DecoderLayer, AscendStep5RMSNorm
+
+
+class AscendStep5MultiTokenPredictorLayer(Step5MultiTokenPredictorLayer):
+    """Upstream predictor layer with the draft block swapped to Ascend."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        # Bypass the parent __init__: it hardcodes the CUDA
+        # Step5DecoderLayer. Everything else mirrors it verbatim so
+        # module/parameter names stay checkpoint-compatible.
+        nn.Module.__init__(self)
+        # The DSA modules hold python-side per-layer state; stay eager.
+        self.do_not_compile = True
+        mtp_vllm_config = _get_mtp_vllm_config(vllm_config)
+        config = mtp_vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config
+        self.fp32_residual_connection = config.fp32_residual_connection
+        quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+        self.enorm = AscendStep5RMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            zero_centered=config.zero_centered,
+            dtype=get_step5_norm_dtype(config),
+        )
+        self.hnorm = AscendStep5RMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            zero_centered=config.zero_centered,
+            dtype=get_step5_norm_dtype(config),
+        )
+        self.eh_proj = nn.Linear(config.hidden_size * 2, config.hidden_size, bias=False)
+        self.shared_head = Step5MTPSharedHead(config=config, quant_config=quant_config, prefix=f"{prefix}.shared_head")
+        self.mtp_block = AscendStep5DecoderLayer(
+            mtp_vllm_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.mtp_block",
+        )
+
+
+class AscendStep5MultiTokenPredictor(Step5MultiTokenPredictor):
+    """Upstream predictor whose layers use the Ascend draft blocks."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = ""):
+        nn.Module.__init__(self)
+        config = _get_mtp_config(vllm_config)
+        self.embed_tokens = VocabParallelEmbedding(
+            config.vocab_size,
+            config.hidden_size,
+        )
+        self.mtp_start_layer_idx = config.num_hidden_layers
+        self.num_mtp_layers = config.num_nextn_predict_layers
+        if self.num_mtp_layers <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"Step5 MTP requires num_nextn_predict_layers > 0, got {self.num_mtp_layers}.")
+        # to map the exact layer index from weights
+        self.layers = torch.nn.ModuleDict(
+            {
+                str(idx): AscendStep5MultiTokenPredictorLayer(
+                    vllm_config=vllm_config,
+                    prefix=f"{prefix}.layers.{idx}",
+                )
+                for idx in range(
+                    self.mtp_start_layer_idx,
+                    self.mtp_start_layer_idx + self.num_mtp_layers,
+                )
+            }
+        )
+
+        self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(config.vocab_size)
+
+
+class AscendStep5MTP(Step5MTP):
+    """Step5MTP for Ascend: same wire format, Ascend draft decoder layer."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = ""):
+        # Bypass Step5MTP.__init__ (it builds the CUDA predictor); the body
+        # below replicates it with the Ascend predictor.
+        nn.Module.__init__(self)
+        # The target VL model maps quantization exclusions to
+        # language_model.*. Draft modules live at model.* and must not
+        # mutate the target config.
+        if vllm_config.quant_config is not None:
+            quant_config = deepcopy(vllm_config.quant_config)
+            quant_config.apply_vllm_mapper(WeightsMapper(orig_to_new_prefix={"language_model.": ""}))
+            vllm_config = replace(vllm_config, quant_config=quant_config)
+        self.config = _get_mtp_config(vllm_config)
+        self.vllm_config = vllm_config
+        self.model = AscendStep5MultiTokenPredictor(vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "model"))
+        # Expose the first draft head to the generic sharing policy. Each MTP
+        # layer retains its own checkpoint head for compute_logits.
+        self.lm_head = self.model.layers[str(self.model.mtp_start_layer_idx)].shared_head.head
+        self.moe_layers: list = []
+        if not _is_step5_mtp_dense(self.model):
+            raise NotImplementedError("Step5 MTP supports dense draft layers only")
+        # Expose the actual draft topology so dense MTP forwards do not
+        # inherit the target model's DP collectives.
+        self.is_dense_mtp = True
+        _set_step5_moe_protocol_metadata(self, None)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""aclnn GenericBlockSparseAttention adapter.
+
+Wraps ``generic_block_sparse_attention`` (+ its AICPU metadata op) from
+ops-transformer as the exact-attention replacement for the Triton
+``sparse_attention_decode`` / ``sparse_attention_prefill`` kernels.
+
+Contract parity with the previous pack + Triton chain:
+
+- ``ids`` is the ``indexer_score_topk`` output: ``[G*T, topk]`` int32 logical
+  region ids, ascending, ``-1`` tail padding, current region NOT included
+  (the fused indexer's mask3 bound keeps it out of the top-k pool).
+- The current region ``floor(position / region_size)`` is appended here into
+  a ``topk + 1`` wide tensor at slot ``count`` -- the same slot the Triton
+  pack kernels (``decode_pack_from_ids`` / ``prefill_pack_from_ids``) used
+  for their extra column -- so a full top-k selection plus the current
+  region still fits without evicting a selected id.
+- ``mask_mode=CAUSAL`` with right-aligned varlen (``cu_seqlens_q`` +
+  ``seqused_kv``) reproduces the per-token causal truncation the pack
+  kernels expressed through per-region ``valid`` counts: query ``i`` of a
+  request sits at kv position ``seqused_kv - q_len + i`` and attends only
+  tokens at positions ``<=`` its own.
+- K/V stay in the native paged layout: the Step5 KV cache is
+  ``[num_blocks, page_size, G, D]``, which is exactly the operator's
+  ``PA_BBND`` layout, so the 4-D views are passed through untouched and the
+  operator resolves logical region -> physical page through ``block_table``.
+
+The AICPU metadata op is split out (``gbsa_sparse_attention_metadata``): it
+schedules from the per-row block COUNTS and the seq-len tensors only and
+never reads the id values, and the counts are a function of the query
+positions alone (``min(topk, floor(pos / region_size)) + 1``), identical for
+every layer in a step. So the metadata is generated once per step in the
+attention metadata builder -- outside the model graph, cf. the FA3 scheduler
+tiling -- and the per-layer forward passes it straight through.
+
+``is_consistent_topk`` is fixed to ``False``: live counts vary per row in
+serving, and the operator's consistent-count fast path does not apply.
+
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm_ascend.ops.triton.step5.summary_update import append_current_region
+
+_SPARSE_PATTERN_PER_GROUP_PER_TOKEN = 4
+_MASK_CAUSAL = 1
+_QUANT_NONE = 0
+_SOFTMAX_PRECISION_FP32 = 1
+
+
+def gbsa_expected_counts(
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    groups: int,
+    region_size: int,
+    topk: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Live block counts the fused path yields for these positions.
+
+    The fused indexer fills exactly ``min(top_k, floor(pos / region_size))``
+    slots per row (its mask3 pool is the regions strictly below the current
+    one) and the current-region append adds one more, so the per-row count is
+    ``min(topk, floor(pos / region_size)) + 1`` -- a function of the position
+    only. This is what ``_append_current_region`` produces from the real ids,
+    and it is identical for every layer in a step, which is what lets the
+    AICPU metadata be built once per step outside the model.
+
+    Returns ``counts [G, T]`` int32 (contiguous, group-major).
+    """
+    live = (positions.to(torch.int32) // region_size).clamp(max=topk)
+    return (live + 1).unsqueeze(0).expand(groups, -1).contiguous()
+
+
+def gbsa_sparse_attention_metadata(
+    counts: torch.Tensor,

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""aclnn IndexerRegionScore (fused score + topk + sort) adapter.
+
+Wraps ``indexer_region_score`` from ops-transformer, which fuses region
+scoring, causal masking (mask_mode=3) and TopK selection with ascending
+logical-id sort (``top_k`` + ``sort_mode=1``) into a single operator call.
+
+The operator returns ``(scores [G,T,R], ids [G,T,top_k])`` and allocates
+the INT32 id output itself (ascending logical region ids, ``-1`` padded).
+With ``top_k > 0`` the causal path prunes K macros per request -- regions
+beyond a row's visible range are neither fetched nor scored nor written --
+so the masked score columns and the ``[max_region_len, R_out)`` tail are
+**unspecified**; only the visible candidates' scores are guaranteed and
+must be the only columns consumed as scores. The operator performs **no**
+physical-page mapping, current-region append or metadata packing — those
+stay in the Triton pack kernels (``_decode_pack_kernel`` /
+``_append_current_region_kernel``), whose ``ids [rows, topk]`` input
+contract is satisfied by a zero-copy reshape of the operator output.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+
+
+def indexer_score_topk(
+    index_q: torch.Tensor,
+    weights: torch.Tensor,
+    mean_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    actual_kv_lengths: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    max_region_len: int,
+    topk: int,
+    region_size: int = 8,
+    # Weights arrive pre-scaled by H**-0.5 (model.py scales them before the
+    # attention call), so no extra scaling is applied here.
+    head_scale: float = 1.0,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Fused score + topk + sort via aclnnIndexerRegionScore.
+
+    Args:
+        index_q:  [T, G, H, D] — float8_e4m3fn from the fused indexer
+            norm+rope kernel (quantized at the store); bf16 inputs from the
+            non-fused fallback path are quantized here.
+        weights:  [T, G, H] fp32 — signed per-head weights.
+        mean_cache: [P, S, 1, D] float8_e4m3fn — paged summary cache.
+        block_table: [N, C] int32 — logical-to-physical page map.
+        cu_seq_lens: [N+1] int32 — cumulative packed query lengths.
+        actual_kv_lengths: [N] int32 — effective KV sequence length of
+            each request including the current queries (``seq_len``;
+            mask_mode=3 causal input). The operator restores the first
+            query position as ``actual_kv_lengths[n] - q_len`` (``q_len``
+            from ``cu_seq_lens``) and selects only from regions strictly
+            below ``floor((ctx + j) / region_size)``, i.e. the current
+            region never competes for a slot.
+        max_region_len: number of logical regions to score.
+        topk: history candidate count.
+        region_size: tokens per region (8).
+
+    Returns:
+        (ids [G*T, topk] int32) — ``ids`` rows hold logical region ids in
+        ascending order with ``-1`` tail padding, the exact contract of
+        ``region_topk_ids`` / ``topk_select_new`` outputs. With ``top_k > 0``
+        only the causally visible score columns are defined (the operator
+        skips fetching/scoring/writing masked macros); masked and tail
+        columns must not be consumed as scores.
+    """
+    tokens, groups = index_q.shape[:2]
+    ids = index_q.new_empty((groups, tokens, topk), dtype=torch.int32)
+    torch.ops._C_ascend.npu_indexer_region_score.ids_out(
+        index_q.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+        weights,
+        mean_cache,
+        actual_kv_lengths,
+        block_table,
+        cu_seq_lens,
+        max_region_len=max_region_len,
+        top_k=topk,
+        region_size=region_size,
+        head_scale=head_scale,
+        cache_mode=1,
+        mask_mode=3,
+        sort_mode=1,
+        selected_region_ids=ids,
+    )
+
+    return ids.reshape(groups * tokens, topk)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Ascend Step5 DSA (sparse attention) backend for vLLM 0.33 / MRV2.
+
+Structure follows the CUDA implementation shipped in vLLM 0.33
+(``vllm.models.step5.nvidia.sparse_attention``): CSA region state lives in
+the upstream deterministic layout --
+
+* one ``Step5CSATailRing`` per request inside its own KV block, addressed as
+  ``block_table[req] * rows_per_block + position % capacity`` (the slot
+  allocation has no atomics, no async assertions and no cross-step state);
+* one FP8 summary per closed eight-token region in a
+  ``Step5SparseSummaryCacheLayer`` page that shares the DSA layer's block
+  ids, so block lifetime and prefix caching follow the normal KV manager.
+
+The heavy compute stays on the operators proven on Ascend MRV1: region
+scoring / causal top-k / ascending sort are fused into the aclnn
+``IndexerRegionScore`` operator, and the exact sparse attention runs in the
+aclnn ``GenericBlockSparseAttention`` operator reading the paged KV cache
+directly (``PA_BBND``). The AICPU scheduling metadata of the attention
+operator is built once per step inside the metadata builder -- outside the
+model graph, like the FA3 scheduler tiling -- and shared across all layers.
+
+The prefill plan is computed synchronously in the builder (one existing
+D2H round trip for ``seq_lens``, host-side grouping, persistent device
+buffers); nothing in the prefill path stages temporary pinned host tensors
+or relies on cross-step event ordering.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, ClassVar
+
+import torch
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context, is_forward_context_available
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import (
+    AttentionBackend,
+    AttentionCGSupport,
+    AttentionImplBase,
+    AttentionMetadata,
+    AttentionMetadataBuilder,
+    CommonAttentionMetadata,
+    MultipleOf,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.utils import split_decodes_and_prefills
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import AttentionSpec
+
+from vllm_ascend.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_pool.ascend_store.attention_fence import attention_transfer_window
+from vllm_ascend.models.step5.ops.generic_block_sparse_attention import (
+    gbsa_expected_counts,
+    gbsa_sparse_attention,
+    gbsa_sparse_attention_metadata,
+)
+from vllm_ascend.models.step5.ops.indexer_region_score import indexer_score_topk
+from vllm_ascend.ops.triton.step5.summary_update import (
+    build_prefill_groups,
+    update_decode,
+    update_prefill,
+    update_verify,
+)
+from vllm_ascend.utils import vllm_version_is
+
+if vllm_version_is("0.33.0"):
+    from vllm.models.step5.nvidia.csa_tail_ring import Step5CSATailRing  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
+    from vllm.models.step5.nvidia.sparse_summary_cache import (  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
+        Step5SparseSummaryBackend,
+        Step5SparseSummaryCacheLayer,
+        Step5SparseSummaryMetadataBuilder,
+    )
+else:
+    from vllm.models.step5.common.csa_tail_ring import Step5CSATailRing  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
+    from vllm.models.step5.common.sparse_summary_cache import (  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
+        Step5SparseSummaryBackend,
+        Step5SparseSummaryCacheLayer,
+        Step5SparseSummaryMetadataBuilder,

+
+
+class AscendStep5CSATailRing(Step5CSATailRing):
+    """Tail ring on the main KV page, sized exactly as upstream sizes it.
+
+    The inherited spec keeps the ring's ``CircularBufferSpec`` on the main
+    layer's page bytes (96 KiB here, capacity 96 rows for the required
+    ``7 + num_speculative_tokens``), so the ring group and the attention
+    groups share one stride class inside the single envelope backing
+    (vllm_ascend.models.step5.cache_config): every per-id byte span is
+    aligned to the same grid, so spans of different groups can only
+    intersect at identical block ids, which the exclusive id pool already
+    forbids. The recycled-block zeroer likewise sees one whole-page stride
+    per start address, so no per-class stack shift is needed.
+    """
+
+
+class AscendStep5SparseSummaryCacheLayer(Step5SparseSummaryCacheLayer):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        prefix: str,
+        target_impl: Any,
+        static_forward_context: dict[str, Any],

+            prefix=prefix,
+            target_impl=target_impl,
+            static_forward_context=static_forward_context,

+        # The DSA impl reads this group's metadata from the forward context;
+        # naming it here keeps the lookup independent of name construction.
+        target_impl.summary_layer_name = self.layer_name

+    def get_attn_backend(self) -> type[AscendStep5SparseSummaryBackend]:
+        return AscendStep5SparseSummaryBackend

+@dataclass
+class AscendStep5SparseSummaryMetadata(AttentionMetadata):
+    """Addresses from the summary KV group, in full-batch token/request order.

+    The summary layer forms its own KV cache group on Ascend, so its manager
+    block ids differ from the DSA layer's. Every summary read and write must
+    go through these tensors -- the MRV2 runner swaps the common metadata to
+    each group's own slot mapping / block table before calling this builder,
+    and graph replay refreshes those persistent buffers in place.
+    """
+
+    slot_mapping: torch.Tensor
+    block_table: torch.Tensor
+
